body.text: There is nothing to report from {param:town} this month. Our stores are {perception:stores} and the work goes on.
I have put the men to the walls and to the powder store. You did not ask me to and I did not ask you. It seemed to me a thing worth doing and I have done it.
We are laying in grain beyond what we will eat. I would not want it said that this town could be made to do anything by a bad winter.
I imagine none of this troubles you. It has been some time since anything I wrote did.
I tell you plainly because I would rather you heard it from me.

options.label: tell him the town's business is its prosperity
options.text: Walls do not feed anybody and powder is not a crop. Turn this town to what it is for{insert:edge}, and let the Crown worry about who might come.

edge.annoyed: , which is trade and not soldiering

options.label: tell him you have not forgotten him
options.text: You have had little from me and I know it. I would rather you asked me for something than built against the day you could not.

tone.hateful: I shall read the next one more carefully.
